scripts.features:
The script is a comprehensive Lua automation utility for the Roblox game "untitled boxing game," built on the Obsidian UI library. It provides a wide range of combat assistance features, including auto-parry, auto-punish, anti-counter, auto-block, and full-auto mode, all driven by live game state reads from the character's data. silent firing, and infinite stamina The script also includes specialized automation for the Surgeon Pinpoint and Shotgun Barrage style mechanics, solving the timing and cycling logic automatically. Input protection features prevent reverse input effects from disrupting dashes and pause the script when the window is unfocused or the user is typing. Additional customization tools allow equipping gloves, titles, and maps directly from the UI, with server-side attempts where possible. The interface includes a draggable toggle button, keybind menu, theme and save managers, and a live ping/uptime display, making it a full-featured control panel.

Combat automation: Auto-parry, auto-punish, anti-counter, auto-block, and full-auto modes react to enemy attacks and stamina in real time.

Style-specific assists: Automates Surgeon Pinpoint cycling and solves the Shotgun Barrage reload minigame with user-adjustable timing and margins.
Input protection: Disables reverse input effects by sending explicit move vectors and pauses all automation when tabbed out or typing.
Customization tools: Equip gloves with effects, apply titles and maps via game events or UI clicks, with searchable dropdown lists from game data.
Full UI suite: Obsidian-based interface with keybinds, theme and save managers, draggable toggle button, notification settings, and live ping/uptime stats.
